args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background, Streets of Rage 2 pixel art, strictly flat orthographic side view, the camera looks straight at the wall with NO perspective and no vanishing point, no text, no letters, no logos, no people. Street at the foot of Moscow City business district: wide sidewalk along the glass and grey stone base of an office tower with a cafe window, young linden trees in square granite planters, a street lamp, tall glass skyscrapers of Moscow City rising behind to the top edge. Floor: grey granite sidewalk paving. Overcast bright summer daylight, muted realistic colors matched to the neighbouring screen.
